# with-skills

> Generate llms.txt from a README.

## Problem
Without this repo, agents read the whole tree to learn the interface.

## Install
    pip install with-skills

## Usage
Run the generator against a repo directory.

## Contracts
- input: README.md
- output: llms.txt

## Family
Consumed by every repo in the family.

Language: loomground — guide https://github.com/flxk1/loomground/blob/main/llms.txt (the .lg language an agent reads, emits, validates); catalogue https://github.com/flxk1/loomground/blob/main/CATALOGUE.json
Skills: alpha
MCP tools: workspace_ask, workspace_lock
